newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: German economic delegation meets Yugoslavs.
newsitem.headline: German economic delegation meets Yugoslavs.

text.p: A 60-member delegation of Germany's top industrial and commercial companies met their Yugoslav counterparts in Belgrade on Monday to discuss ways to boost cooperation.
"It is not by accident that the German delegation is visiting us just a few days after lifting of sanctions," Yugoslav deputy prime minister Jovan Zebic told his guests.
"Germany is traditionally one of our most important partners," Zebic said.
The U.N. Security Council lifted sanctions against Belgrade last week.

Germany is ready to resume all forms of economic cooperation with Yugoslavia in keeping with a long and successful tradition, the German delegation head, deputy German Minister of Economy, Hans Schilla said.
The delegation includes representatives of giants like Siemens, Hoechst, Thyssen, Krupp, Boss-Telecomm, ABB, Mercedes-Benz and others.
The value of Yugoslav-German trade in the first eight months of this year totalled $365 million.
